run_auto_round_llm_quantization: run auto_round CLI to quantize an LLM model with specified format and evaluation tasks
run_auto_round_mllm_quantization: run auto_round CLI with --mllm flag to quantize a multimodal language model
run_auto_round_layer_config: run auto_round CLI with --layer_config to set per-layer quantization bits and data types
parse_layer_config_arg: parse a JSON-like layer configuration string into a dictionary of layer names and quantization settings
test_auto_round_eval_help: run auto_round CLI with --eval --lmms -h to display evaluation help for multimodal models
